displayName: Effectivity (from when / from which serial, lot or unit a definition state holds)
description: The effectivity of a definition state as the system that owns it states it (PLM, SAP ECM): by date, serial number, lot or unit, for an end item, under an engineering change. Carried as data for traceability — the ERP resolves it when it explodes the bill into the order; nothing here evaluates it.

properties.name: effectivity_id
properties.description: Identity of the effectivity as the source names it.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: How the effectivity is stated: Date, SerialNumber, Lot or Unit.

properties.name: range_from
properties.description: Start of the range as the source writes it (a date, a serial number or a lot number).

properties.name: range_to
properties.description: End of the range as the source writes it; empty = open.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The operations definition this effectivity qualifies.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: operations_material_bill_ref
properties.description: The material bill this effectivity qualifies.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: operations_material_bill_item_ref
properties.description: The bill item this effectivity qualifies.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: end_item_ref
properties.description: The end product whose serial numbers, lots or units the range counts.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: engineering_change_ref
properties.description: The engineering change (ECN, SAP change number) under which the effectivity was set.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an extension object has no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

isa95.mappingNote: B2MML 0701 states effectivity only as EffectiveStartDate / EffectiveEndDate on a definition; an effectivity by serial number, lot or unit, its end item and its engineering change have no B2MML object. An extension (PLAN-0700 L5, owner 29.10.2026).
